posts.zh:
visual-review 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f0bce44e51aab7cf8b1f.html
posts.en:
visual-review is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f0bce44e51aab7cf8b1f.html
